verdict.rationale: Jan explicitly supports downloading and running LLMs locally with 'full control and privacy,' branding itself as 'Privacy First' where 'everything runs locally when you want it to,' and offers a local OpenAI-compatible API server — directly matching the power-user's need to keep data on-device. Community mention confirms real-world usage, though it's not deeply detailed. Missing for 10: independent technical verification of offline/air-gapped operation and no confirmation that telemetry is fully disabled by default.
